method: human visual audit of audit_crops/*.jpg (cluster members + 20 random candidates projected into a real capture photo, refined production pose, frozen K). Labels: TRUE=image region is mirror/glass/specular/glossy content consistent with a virtual-reflection or specular-smear point; AMB=specular-capable but could be real surface (satin quilt, varnished wardrobe); FP=looks like real solid geometry or plain weak-texture surface (detector false positive for the specular-trail hypothesis).
auditor: E2-A agent (Claude), 2026-07-18; single-rater, not user-approved ground truth
